Who this class is for

For women who want to understand what’s really going on in midlife.

  • Women in their 40s and 50s curious about how ADHD and perimenopause can overlap.
  • Anyone who has heard about late ADHD diagnoses in women and wants the clear, friendly version.
  • Women who want practical routines that work with changing energy, not against it.
  • Partners, friends and managers who want to understand and support someone they care about.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why midlife is when so many women first hear about ADHD

The research conversation around hormones and attention, explained in plain English.

Where ADHD and perimenopause overlap

Why focus, memory and overwhelm can shift in midlife, and why it can be hard to tell what is what.

Routines that flex with your energy

Simple planning ideas for weeks when energy and focus go up and down.

Getting the most from a GP appointment

How to prepare, what to write down beforehand and the questions worth asking.

Asking for support at work

How to talk to a manager about adjustments, with confidence and without oversharing.

Questions

Before you book your seat

Do I need a diagnosis to join?

No. The class is for anyone who wants to understand ADHD and perimenopause better, for themselves or for someone they care about.

What if I can’t make it live?

Every seat includes the replay, so you can watch it when it suits you.

Is this medical advice?

No. It’s an educational class. It doesn’t diagnose or treat anything and doesn’t replace your GP or another medical professional.

Why only £17?

Because learning this shouldn’t be a big decision. Come, take what helps, and decide afterwards whether you’d like more support.

Script 1 · “Why now?”

“Why are so many women first hearing the word ADHD in their forties?”

Body

“Part of the answer may be hormones. As oestrogen changes in perimenopause, research suggests focus and memory can change too, and for some women that’s when ADHD traits become harder to manage.”

“I’m running a live 60-minute masterclass on where ADHD and perimenopause meet. Seats are £17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up.”
